title: Pairs chart
description: Which text may sit on which fill in one brand of a scheme, and the contrast each pair keeps, in each mode. Drawn by the PairsChart composite on Foundations › Color.

text.description: The text token's full name, such as color.text.primary.

primitive.description: The primitive the text ends at in this mode, such as color.slate.light.900.

hex.description: The primitive's value, which the chart prints.

contrast.description: The WCAG contrast of the text on the fill, to two decimals.

floor.description: The least contrast this pair needs, when it differs from the chart's floor.

fill.description: The fill token's full name, such as color.surface.canvas.

primitive.description: The primitive the fill ends at in this mode.

hex.description: The primitive's value, which the chart prints.

pairs.description: Every text token that may sit on this fill.

floor.description: The least contrast every pair needs, such as 4.5.

modes.description: The pairs in each mode, light first.

fills.description: The fills by the text they take.

page.description: The page's own surfaces; the page's text sits on them.

light.description: Light fills; they take on-light text.

dark.description: Dark fills; they take on-dark text.
